designationHistory.name: Pigeon Creek Refuge (Refuge No. 1)
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established Refuge No. 1, the Pigeon Creek Refuge, as a game sanctuary and refuge in the Ouachita National Forest, Arkansas.

authority.citation: Proclamation 2119, Mar. 8, 1935, 49 Stat. 3439 (under Act of June 13, 1933, 48 Stat. 128)
